fixed_execution_rules: Root runs all instrumentations serially in this order, using whole class selectors; no source edits, Gradle, compatibility benchmarks, APK/tree hashing or competing instrumentation during timing.
Record exact installed app/appTest hashes and source/build bindings before first use and every side switch; verify each run uses the planned bytes. Preserve APKs and immutable raw receipts.
Record environment immediately before and after each native invocation. Matching configuration is required for pairing but does not prove equal instantaneous load, ART/GC or caches.
Run the existing entire Tile class; retain its pan/zoom prelude and unchanged local 1/4/8-layer loop. Record any observed test ordering change instead of silently pooling altered order.
Keep every original method deadline/assertion. Process-level outer timeout does not replace or extend a 30/60/90-second inner gate.
Use existing synthetic test setup/cleanup. Do not add prewarming, reinstall loops, forced GC, database clearing or fixture reductions to select faster results.
If instrumentation fails, retain its log/exit/test count, confirm process/worker cleanup before another invocation, and do not silently substitute a rerun.

diagnostic_tile.evidence: Retain every per-layer wall/CPU endpoint sample. Check metadata work/counters and pixels remain consistent while measuring the new hex/result interval. CPU is cumulative guest-thread CPU, not exclusive coroutine CPU or host cycles. Hex now includes SHA finalization+stdlib conversion+result allocation.
diagnostic_tile.success_boundary: A real drop in hex/result cost supports this targeted change; it does not alone close append regression. No timing threshold invented from a single diagnostic sample.

tile_default_off.required: Both tests pass every invocation, all 1/4/8 append/destructive-frame pixel assertions pass, same workload/counters and resource assertions remain. No diagnostic array should appear when disabled. Disable diagnostics by omitting runner --diagnostics and the instrumentation diagnostic argument; test default is false and receipt diagnostics=false. Do not modify the runner to pass an explicit false value.
tile_default_off.latency_reporting: Report each of the four raw runs, per-layer initial/append/forced-full values and metadata/raster/publication. Report new two-per-side median/range descriptively; never claim significance or mix with old APK samples. Keep original 1435.516→6427.580ms regression visible.
tile_default_off.acceptance: Assess each layer separately; do not hide a single-layer regression behind 4/8-layer means. One fast tail sample or hex-stage improvement is insufficient to declare closure. Material persistent regression keeps delivery on hold and requires a specific next diagnostic.

frame_probe.required: One test/14 frame records per side: initial + 12 mixed transforms + separated append, all same-version cold pixelsEqual, bitmap budget and existing assertions; retain writer SQLite settings.
frame_probe.metrics: Per-frame wall/stage/decode/snapshotReadRows/rebuilt/native/cache counters; separately compare initial, the 12-case mixed sequence median and separated append. Candidate geometry reuse should preserve zero decode/read for transforms and sparse dirty-region read savings; unexpected count changes require inspection.
frame_probe.limits: Twelve different transforms are not twelve repetitions of one workload. Baseline missing optional counters remain null, never zero; pixel oracle is within version.

measurements_and_acceptance.native_stroke: One test/four phases; existing expected native counts 2/2/1/0, greater per-tile reference counts when nonzero, whole bitmap equality, cut masks, crop and finite page clipping and bitmap bounds must pass. Per-tile reference counts are same-process differential evidence, not measured old-production baseline counters.
measurements_and_acceptance.streamed_full: All four methods must be executed and reported. Cancel/pending geometry release and omitted-frame isolation assertions remain. Dense is 1201 strokes/76802 points; bounded is 258/8226. Both frame deadlines remain 30000ms with fixture/editor setup outside; successful frame cases must reach final red pixel, full snapshot rows, >1 batch and verified-and-released assertions. Bounded PASS cannot replace dense FAIL.

compatibility_and_risks: Only SHA digest hex representation changed; clocks, transaction/revision/epoch checks, spatial queries, cache and drawing algorithm are unchanged. Signature identity affects tile reuse, so pixel/work-count regressions are blockers.

The exact Kotlin 2.3.10 stdlib passed 1869 host equivalence checks (all byte values, empty/full byte arrays, six SHA arrays, 7 locales). This establishes tested host output compatibility, not Android linkage, ART execution or native speed; APK build and these native runs must cover the latter.
No new wrapper/encoder/dependency or duplicate stdlib unit tests. Retain host compatibility receipt separately from runtime results.
Current diagnosis does not prove Formatter is the source of the complete slowdown; query+digest also regressed and shared source, guest CPU and GC observations do not establish its cause.

failure_handling.missing_tests_or_metrics: Mark incomplete; preserve exact executed/expected counts and missing stage, do not count compile success as runtime PASS.
failure_handling.pixels_or_state_or_release_failure: Functional blocker. Preserve raw failure/stacks and compare the one-line change/signature results before proposing the smallest relevant correction; no deadline/fixture relaxation.
failure_handling.dense_timeout: Keep original dense gate FAILED and report reached/unreached assertions and stage/worker/resource evidence. Do not attribute solely to TCG or use the smaller test to close it.
failure_handling.hex_stage_does_not_improve: Do not claim optimization success. Check representation/runtime path and phase overhead; avoid speculative broad cache/query refactors.
failure_handling.default_off_regression_persists: Hold completion. Retain all samples and prioritize a minimal query+digest split or specific reproducible code issue; no blind native reuse rollback without supporting evidence.
failure_handling.environment_or_artifact_mismatch: Flag that run as not directly paired, preserve it, and obtain an explicitly recorded next run plan rather than choosing favorable samples.
